snippet.title: October Panic Official Trailer
snippet.description:
It's a Halloween Party!

October Panic has 5 levels – but it has over 30 unique enemy types! Everyone is invited to this October celebration. So get the spooky electro-swing pumping, smack a plastic mask over your kisser, and get ready to bob for some god-damned apples as the Vampire, the Mummy, the Monster, his Bride or the elusive Creature.

Published by Burning Planet Digital:
https://www.burningplanet.se

October Panic on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3165420/October_Panic/
